title: Molecular docking, network pharmacology, and QSAR modelling studies of benzo[c]phenanthridines - novel antileishmaniasis agents.
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用分子对接、网络药理学和QSAR建模研究苯并[c]菲啶类抗利什曼病药物，虽涉及分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联极弱。
abstract: Leishmaniasis treatment primarily relies on chemotherapy due to lack of vaccines. However, the low efficacy, parasite resistance, and toxicity associated with existing drugs necessitate the development of effective and safer therapies. Fuchino et al. reported promising leishmanicidal activity in a series of benzo[c]phenanthridines against L. major promastigotes. To progress these compounds towards drug development, it is crucial to understand their molecular targets, mechanisms of action, binding interactions, and structural requirements. In this research, molecular docking, network pharmacology, 2D-QSAR, and 3D-QSAR CoMFA studies were performed on 30 benzo[c]phenanthridines. Docking analysis showed that all molecules had a strong binding affinity to L. major-nucleoside diphosphate kinase (NDPK) compared to the other targets. 10-isopropoxy sanguinarine had the highest binding affinity (-10.6 kcal/mol) and formed ionic and hydrophobic interactions. Network pharmacology analysis of the most active compounds identified serine/threonine-protein kinase Mtor as a potential antileishmaniasis target in humans for benzo[c]phenanthridines. This was confirmed with high-affinity scores > -7.0 kcal/mol for all the compounds docked. GO and KEGG pathway enrichment identified Reg. of fatty acid oxidation (BP), TORC1 complex (CC), RNA polymerase III type 1 promoter sequence-specific DNA binding (MF), and Acute myeloid leukemia (KEGG pathway) to be highly enriched with the hub genes. Both 2D and 3D-QSAR CoMFA models satisfied the internal and external validation tests as follows: 2D-QSAR: R(2)(Train) = 0.9040, Q(2)cv = 0.8648, R(2)adj = 0.8838, and R(2)(Test) = 0.8740; and 3D-QSAR: r(2) = 0.998, q(2) = 0.526, and SDEP = 0.856. The molecules can be practically evaluated as superior antileishmaniasis agents.
abstract_zh: 利什曼病治疗主要依赖化疗，因为缺乏疫苗。然而，现有药物疗效低、寄生虫耐药性及毒性问题，亟需开发有效且更安全的疗法。Fuchino等人报道了一系列苯并[c]菲啶类化合物对L. major前鞭毛体具有有前景的杀利什曼活性。为了将这些化合物推进至药物开发阶段，理解其分子靶点、作用机制、结合相互作用及结构要求至关重要。在本研究中，对30种苯并[c]菲啶类化合物进行了分子对接 (molecular docking)、网络药理学 (network pharmacology)、2D-QSAR和3D-QSAR CoMFA研究。对接分析显示，与其他靶点相比，所有分子对L. major-核苷二磷酸激酶 (nucleoside diphosphate kinase, NDPK) 均表现出强结合亲和力。10-异丙氧基血根碱具有最高结合亲和力（-10.6 kcal/mol），并形成离子和疏水相互作用。对最活跃化合物的网络药理学分析确定了丝氨酸/苏氨酸蛋白激酶Mtor为人类中苯并[c]菲啶类化合物的潜在抗利什曼病靶点。这通过所有对接化合物的高亲和力得分（> -7.0 kcal/mol）得到确认。GO和KEGG通路富集分析确定了脂肪酸氧化调控（BP）、TORC1复合物（CC）、RNA聚合酶III型1启动子序列特异性DNA结合（MF）和急性髓系白血病（KEGG通路）与核心基因高度富集。2D和3D-QSAR CoMFA模型均满足内部和外部验证测试，具体如下：2D-QSAR：R²(训练集) = 0.9040，Q²cv = 0.8648，R²adj = 0.8838，R²(测试集) = 0.8740；3D-QSAR：r² = 0.998，q² = 0.526，SDEP = 0.856。这些分子可实际评估为优越的抗利什曼病药物。
